value.rationale: The intrinsic full symmetry group of this canonical Platonic graph acts on a known 23-dimensional homology group. The exact rational decomposition reveals a nontrivial six-dimensional rational constituent and a 12-dimensional antipodal-odd eigenspace, neither determined by known homology ranks. The natural rotation and full-symmetry quotients have distinct reduced rational homology (Q^2 in degree 2 versus acyclicity). This is a complete intrinsic group-character invariant and motivated quotient boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
